ko.title: 9일간의 정전, 7명의 사망자, 단절된 전력: 시속 99마일 폭풍 이후 게리 시의 더딘 복구 현장

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: 강력한 폭풍이 인디애나주 북서부를 쓸고 간 지 일주일이 넘었지만, 게리 시와 레이크군 전역의 수만 가구와 사업체는 여전히 전기가 들어오지 않고 있으며, 당국은 8월 25일이 되어서야 완전히 복구될 것으로 예상한다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: 지역 비상 관리 담당자에 따르면, 이번 폭풍은 시속 99마일로 추정되는 강풍을 동반하여 해당 지역 전역의 전신주 수백 개를 부러뜨리거나 넘어뜨리고 전선을 끊어놓았습니다.

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: 피해 규모가 워낙 커서 이번 정전은 이 지역에서 수년 만에 발생한 가장 장기적인 대규모 정전 중 하나가 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## 늘어나는 피해 규모

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: 당국은 폭풍과 그 여파로 인해 7명이 사망한 것으로 집계했으나, 사망 원인 중 일부는 폭풍 자체보다는 장기 정전으로 인한 조건(예: 극심한 더위 노출, 대체 전력이나 난방원 사용 등)과 관련이 있을 수 있다고 경고했습니다.

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: 개별적인 사망 경위에 대한 조사는 아직 진행 중인 것으로 알려졌으며, 당국은 세부 사항이 확인됨에 따라 주민들과 언론에 추측보다는 공식 발표를 신뢰할 것을 당부했습니다.

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: 지역 당국은 피해자들에 대한 추가 신원 정보를 공개하지 않았으며, 주민들에게 애도 및 문의는 카운티 공식 채널을 통해 전달해 줄 것을 요청하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## 휴교령 및 암흑에 휩싸인 교실

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: 게리 지역 학구들은 폭풍으로 인해 도시 전역의 학교에 처음 전력이 끊긴 8월 13일부터 계속 휴교 상태를 유지하고 있습니다.

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: 교육청 관계자들은 전력, 에어컨, 그리고 일부 학교 건물의 안정적인 수압 부족을 학생들을 등교시키지 않는 주요 이유로 들었으며, 아직 정확한 수업 재개 날짜는 발표되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: 학부모와 가족들에게는 수업이 언제 재개될지에 대한 업데이트를 위해 교육청의 공식 안내를 주시할 것이 권장되었습니다.

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## 구명줄이 된 커뮤니티 센터

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: 늦여름 더위 속에서 많은 가구가 여전히 전력, 냉장, 에어컨을 사용하지 못함에 따라, 지역 커뮤니티 센터와 지방 자치 단체 건물이 임시 구호소로 전환되었습니다.

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: 주민들은 다음 항목들을 이용할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - 지역사회 단체와 자원봉사자들이 배풀하는 따뜻한 식사

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - 휴대전화 및 소형 전자기기 충전소

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - 높은 실내 온도를 피할 수 있는 무더위 쉼터(냉방 공간)

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - 지정된 장소에서 배부되는 물과 얼음을 포함한 기본 생필품

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: 시 관계자들은 의료 취약계층, 노약자, 또는 어린 자녀를 돌보는 주민들에게 특히 낮 기온이 최고조에 달할 때 이러한 시설을 적극 이용할 것을 권장했습니다.

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## 시각을 다투는 전력 복구반

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: 이웃 주에서 지원 온 상호 지원팀이 합류한 것으로 알려진 전력 복구반은 피해 지역 전역에서 쓰러진 전신주 교체, 전선 가설, 손상된 인프라 점검 작업을 진행하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 단순한 전선 수리가 아닌 전면 교체가 필요한 전신주의 수가 매우 많아 일반적인 폭풍 복구 작업에 비해 복구 속도가 크게 늘어지고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: 지역 전력회사 대표는 수리로 전력을 회복할 수 있는 고객 수를 기준으로 복구 우선순위를 정하고 있으며, 병원, 수처리 시설 및 기타 주요 기반 시설에 우선적으로 복구가 진행된 후 피해 주민이 가장 밀집된 지역을 대상으로 복구가 이어질 것이라고 말했습니다.

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## 주민들에게 전달된 안내 사항

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: 카운티 관계자들은 주민들에게 다음 사항을 지속적으로 당부하고 있습니다:

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - 끊어져 떨어진 전선에 접근하지 말고, 전력 복구반이 확인하기 전까지는 모든 전선에 전기가 흐르고 있는 것으로 간주할 것

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - 복구반이 이미 인지하고 있을 것이라 지레짐작하지 말고, 공식 전력회사 및 카운티 핫라인을 통해 정전 및 끊어진 전선을 신고할 것

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - 특히 기온이 높은 오후 시간대에 홀로 계신 어르신이나 취약계층 이웃의 안부를 확인할 것

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - 공식 식품 안전 지침에 따라 장시간 전기가 끊긴 냉장 보관 식품은 폐기할 것

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: 복구 목표일로 예상되는 8월 25일이 가까워짐에 따라, 지역 관계자들은 복구 작업이 진행됨에 따라 공식 발표를 통해 지속적으로 최신 정보를 제공할 것이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: 주민들은 정전 현황, 쉼터 위치, 학교 재개교 계획에 대한 가장 최신 정보를 얻기 위해 검증된 지방 정부 및 전력회사 채널을 확인할 것이 권장됩니다.

zh.title: 九天、七死、无电：深入了解印第安纳州加里市从99英里/小时风暴中缓慢恢复的过程

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: 在印第安纳州西北部遭受猛烈风暴袭击一周多后，加里市及莱克县各地仍有数万户家庭和企业处于断电状态，官员们表示，预计要到8月25日才能完全恢复供电。

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: 据当地应急管理官员称，此次风暴产生的阵风时速估计达到99英里，导致该地区数百根电线杆折断或倒塌，电线被扯断。

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: 受损规模使此次停电成为该地区多年来持续时间最长的大范围停电事件之一。

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## 不断扩大的伤亡

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: 官员们已将七起死亡事件与此次风暴及其后果联系起来，尽管当局提醒称，其中一些死亡可能与长期停电导致的状况有关——例如极端高温暴露以及使用替代电力或供暖源——而非风暴本身直接造成。

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: 据报道，针对具体情况的调查仍在进行中，官员们敦促居民和新闻媒体在细节确认之前，应依赖官方声明而非猜测。

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: 地方当局尚未发布有关受害者的进一步身份信息，并要求居民通过官方县级渠道表达哀悼和进行咨询。

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## 学校关闭，教室一片漆黑

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: 自8月13日风暴首次导致全市校园停电以来，加里地区的学区一直处于关闭状态。

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: 学区官员指出，部分建筑物缺乏电力、空调和可靠的水压是让学生留在家中的主要原因，目前尚未宣布明确的复课日期。

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: 建议家庭密切关注学区官方通讯，以获取有关何时恢复上课的最新消息。

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## 社区中心成为生命线

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: 由于许多家庭在夏末高温期间仍缺乏电力、制冷和空调，当地社区中心和市政建筑已被改建为临时救济点。

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: 居民可以获得：

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - 由社区组织和志愿者分发的热餐

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - 手机和小型电子设备的充电站

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - 躲避室内高温的降温区

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - 在指定地点分发的基本物资，包括水和冰块

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: 市政府官员鼓励医疗脆弱群体、老年人或照顾幼儿的居民利用这些场所，特别是在白天高温时段。

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## 公用事业人员与时间赛跑

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: 据报道，在邻近州互助团队的支援下，公用事业人员一直在努力更换倒塌的电线杆、重新架设电线，并检查受影响区域内受损的基础设施。

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: 官员们表示，需要全面更换——而非简单线路维修——的电线杆数量巨大，这使得恢复速度比典型的风暴恢复工作要慢得多。

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: 当地公用事业代表表示，恢复工作正根据单次维修所能恢复的用户数量进行优先排序，医院、水处理设施和其他关键基础设施将优先获得关注，随后是受影响居民最集中的社区。

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## 给居民的建议

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: 县政府官员继续敦促居民：

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - 避开倒塌的电线，并将所有电线视为带电状态，直到公用事业人员确认并非如此

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - 通过官方公用事业和县级热线报告停电和倒塌线路，而不是假设工作人员已经知情

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - 检查老年人或脆弱邻居的情况，特别是在高温的午后

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - 遵循官方食品安全指南，丢弃已长时间断电的冷藏食品

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: 随着该地区接近预计的8月25日恢复目标，当地官员表示，他们将随着维修工作的进展，继续通过官方声明提供最新信息。

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: 鼓励居民关注经过验证的当地政府和公用事业渠道，以获取有关停电状态、避难所位置和学校重新开放计划的最新信息。

segments.tr: उत्तर-पश्चिम इंडियाना में एक हिंसक तूफान के आने के एक सप्ताह से अधिक समय बाद, गैरी और पूरे लेक काउंटी में हज़ारों घर और व्यवसाय बिना बिजली के हैं, और अधिकारियों का कहना है कि 25 अगस्त तक पूरी तरह से बहाली की उम्मीद नहीं है。

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: क्षسति के पैमाने ने इसे क्षेत्र द्वारा हाल के वर्षों में अनुभव किए गए सबसे लंबे समय तक व्यापक आउटेज में से एक बना दिया है。

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## एक बढ़ता हुआ टोल

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने तूफान और उसके बाद की स्थिति से सात मौतों को जोड़ा है, हालांकि अधिकारियों ने चेतावनी दी है कि उनमें से कुछ मौतें लंबे समय तक बिजली गुल रहने के कारण उत्पन्न परिस्थितियों से जुड़ी हो सकती हैं — जैसे अत्यधिक गर्मी का संपर्क और वैकल्पिक बिजली या हीटिंग स्रोतों का उपयोग — न कि खुद तूफान से।

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत परिस्थितियों की जांच कथित तौर पर अभी भी जारी है, और अधिकारियों ने निवासियों और समाचार आउटलेट्स से आग्रह किया है कि वे विवरण की पुष्टि होने पर अटकलें लगाने के बजाय आधिकारिक बयानों पर भरोसा करें。

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने पीड़ितों के बारे में आगे के पहचान विवरण जारी नहीं किए हैं, और निवासियों से आधिकारिक काउंटी चैनलों के माध्यम से संवेदना और पूछताछ करने के लिए कहा जा रहा है。

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## स्कूल बंद, कक्षाएं अंधेरे में

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: गैरी क्षेत्र के स्कूल जिले 13 अगस्त से बंद हैं, जब तूफान ने पहली बार शहर भर के परिसरों की बिजली गुल कर दी थी।

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: जिला अधिकारियों ने छात्रों को घर पर रखने के प्राथमिक कारणों के रूप में कुछ इमारतों में बिजली, एयर कंडीशनिंग और विश्वसनीय पानी के दबाव की कमी का हवाला दिया है, और फिर से खुलने की कोई निश्चित तारीख अभी घोषित नहीं की गई है।

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: कक्षाएं कब फिर से शुरू होंगी, इस पर अपडेट के लिए परिवारों को आधिकारिक स्कूल जिला संचार की निगरानी करने की सलाह दी गई है。

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## कम्युनिटी सेंटर बने जीवन रेखा

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: गर्मियों के अंत की गर्मी के दौरान कई परिवारों के पास अभी भी बिजली, रेफ्रिजरेटर और एयर कंडीशनिंग की कमी के कारण, स्थानीय सामुदायिक केंद्रों और नगरपालिका इमारतों को अस्थायी राहत स्थलों में परिवर्तित कर दिया गया है।

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: निवासी निम्नलिखित तक पहुँच प्राप्त करने में सक्षम रहे हैं:

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - सामुदायिक संगठनों और स्वयंसेवकों द्वारा वितरित गर्म भोजन

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - फोन और छोटे इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स के लिए चार्जिंग स्टेशन

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - घर के अंदर के उच्च तापमान से बचने के लिए कूलिंग क्षेत्र

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - चयनित स्थानों पर वितरित पानी और बर्फ सहित बुनियादी आपूर्ति

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: शहर के अधिकारियों ने उन निवासियों को प्रोत्साहित किया है जो चिकित्सकीय रूप से संवेदनशील हैं, बुजुर्ग हैं, या छोटे बच्चों की देखभाल कर रहे हैं, वे इन साइटों का उपयोग करें, विशेष रूप से दिन के समय की चिलचिलाती गर्मी के दौरान।

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## यूटिलिटी क्रू समय के खिलाफ दौड़ रहे हैं

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: यूटिलिटी क्रू, कथित तौर पर पड़ोसी राज्यों की आपसी सहायता टीमों द्वारा पूरक, गिरे हुए खंभों को बदलने, लाइनों को फिर से जोड़ने और प्रभावित पदचिह्न में क्षतिग्रस्त बुनियादी ढांचे का निरीक्षण करने के लिए काम कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि साधारण लाइन मरम्मत के बजाय पूर्ण प्रतिस्थापन की आवश्यकता वाले खंभों की भारी संख्या ने विशिष्ट तूफान पुनर्प्राप्ति प्रयासों की तुलना में बहाली की गति को काफी धीमा कर दिया है。

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: स्थानीय उपयोगिता प्रतिनिधियों ने कहा है कि बहाली को उन ग्राहकों की संख्या के आधार पर प्राथमिकता दी जा रही है जिन्हें एक निश्चित मरम्मत से बहाल किया जा सकता है, अस्पतालों, जल उपचार सुविधाओं और अन्य महत्वपूर्ण बुनियादी ढांचे को शुरुआती ध्यान मिल रहा है, इसके बाद प्रभावित निवासियों की सबसे बड़ी सांद्रता वाले पड़ोस आते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## निवासियों को क्या बताया जा रहा है

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: काउंटी अधिकारी निवासियों से लगातार आग्रह कर रहे हैं कि:

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - गिरे हुए बिजली के तारों से बचें और जब तक उपयोगिता कर्मियों द्वारा अन्यथा पुष्टि न की जाए, तब तक सभी लाइनों को सक्रिय मानें

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - यह मानने के बजाय कि क्रू को पहले से ही पता है, आधिकारिक उपयोगिता और काउंटी हॉटलाइन के माध्यम से आउटेज और गिरे हुए तारों की रिपोर्ट करें

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - बुजुर्ग या संवेदनशील पड़ोसियों की जाँच करें, विशेष रूप से अत्यधिक गर्मी वाले दोपहर के दौरान

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - आधिकारिक खाद्य-सुरक्षा मार्गदर्शन का पालन करते हुए, लंबे समय तक बिना बिजली के रहे प्रशीतित भोजन को त्याग दें

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे क्षेत्र अनुमानित 25 अगस्त के बहाली लक्ष्य के करीब पहुंच रहा है, स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि वे मरम्मत का काम आगे बढ़ने के साथ आधिकारिक बयानों के माध्यम से अपडेट प्रदान करना जारी रखेंगे।

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: निवासियों को आउटेज की स्थिति, आश्रय स्थानों और स्कूल के फिर से खुलने की योजनाओं पर सबसे अद्यतन जानकारी के लिए सत्यापित स्थानीय सरकार और उपयोगिता चैनलों का पालन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है।

es.title: Nueve días, siete muertes, sin electricidad: La lenta recuperación de Gary, Indiana, tras una tormenta de 99 mph

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: Más de una semana después de que una violenta tormenta azotara el noroeste de Indiana, decenas de miles de hogares y negocios en Gary y en todo el condado de Lake siguen sin electricidad, y las autoridades dicen que no se espera la restauración completa hasta el 25 de agosto.

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: Según los funcionarios locales de gestión de emergencias, la tormenta produjo ráfagas de viento estimadas en 99 millas por hora, rompiendo o derribando cientos de postes de servicios públicos y derribando líneas eléctricas en toda la región.

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: La magnitud de los daños ha hecho que este sea uno de los cortes generalizados más largos que la zona ha experimentado en años.

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## Un saldo creciente

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: Las autoridades han relacionado siete muertes con la tormenta y sus secuelas, aunque han advertido que algunas de esas víctimas mortales pueden estar relacionadas con las condiciones causadas por el corte prolongado —como la exposición al calor extremo y el uso de fuentes alternativas de energía o calefacción— en lugar de la tormenta en sí.

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: Según se informa, las investigaciones sobre las circunstancias individuales siguen en curso, y los funcionarios han instado a los residentes y a los medios de comunicación a confiar en las declaraciones oficiales en lugar de en las especulaciones a medida que se confirman los detalles.

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: Las autoridades locales no han publicado más detalles de identificación sobre las víctimas, y se pide a los residentes que dirijan sus condolencias y consultas a través de los canales oficiales del condado.

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## Escuelas cerradas, aulas a oscuras

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: Los distritos escolares del área de Gary han permanecido cerrados desde el 13 de agosto, cuando la tormenta cortó por primera vez el suministro eléctrico a los campus de toda la ciudad.

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios del distrito han citado la falta de electricidad, aire acondicionado y presión de agua confiable en algunos edificios como las razones principales para mantener a los estudiantes en casa, sin que aún se haya anunciado una fecha firme para la reapertura.

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: Se ha aconsejado a las familias que supervisen las comunicaciones oficiales del distrito escolar para obtener actualizaciones sobre cuándo se reanudarán las clases.

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## Los centros comunitarios se convierten en salvavidas

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: Dado que muchos hogares siguen sin electricidad, refrigeración y aire acondicionado durante el calor de finales de verano, los centros comunitarios locales y los edificios municipales se han convertido en sitios de ayuda improvisados.

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: Los residentes han podido acceder a:

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - Comidas calientes distribuidas por organizaciones comunitarias y voluntarios

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - Estaciones de carga para teléfonos y pequeños aparatos electrónicos

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - Áreas de enfriamiento para escapar de las altas temperaturas interiores

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - Suministros básicos, incluyendo agua y hielo, distribuidos en lugares seleccionados

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la ciudad han alentado a los residentes que son médicamente vulnerables, ancianos o que cuidan a niños pequeños a hacer uso de estos sitios, particularmente durante el calor máximo del día.

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## Las cuadrillas de servicios públicos corren contra el reloj

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: Las cuadrillas de servicios públicos, supuestamente complementadas por equipos de ayuda mutua de estados vecinos, han estado trabajando para reemplazar los postes derribados, volver a tender las líneas e inspeccionar la infraestructura dañada en toda la zona afectada.

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios han dicho que la gran cantidad de postes que requieren un reemplazo completo —en lugar de una simple reparación de línea— ha ralentizado significativamente el ritmo de restauración en comparación con los esfuerzos típicos de recuperación de tormentas.

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: Los representantes de los servicios públicos locales han dicho que la restauración se está priorizando en función de la cantidad de clientes que una reparación determinada puede restaurar, recibiendo atención temprana los hospitales, las instalaciones de tratamiento de agua y otra infraestructura crítica, seguidos por los vecindarios con las mayores concentraciones de residentes afectados.

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## Lo que se les dice a los residentes

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: Los funcionarios del condado continúan instando a los residentes a:

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - Evitar las líneas eléctricas caídas y tratar todas las líneas como energizadas hasta que las cuadrillas de servicios públicos confirmen lo contrario

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - Informar sobre cortes y líneas caídas a través de las líneas directas oficiales de servicios públicos y del condado en lugar de asumir que las cuadrillas ya están al tanto

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - Verificar el estado de los vecinos ancianos o vulnerables, particularmente durante las tardes de mucho calor

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - Desechar los alimentos refrigerados que han estado sin energía durante un período prolongado, siguiendo la guía oficial de seguridad alimentaria

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: A medida que la región se acerca al objetivo de restauración proyectado para el 25 de agosto, los funcionarios locales han dicho que continuarán proporcionando actualizaciones a través de declaraciones oficiales a medida que avance el trabajo de reparación.

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: Se anima a los residentes a seguir los canales verificados del gobierno local y de servicios públicos para obtener la información más actualizada sobre el estado de los cortes, las ubicaciones de los refugios y los planes de reapertura de las escuelas.

ar.title: تسعة أيام، سبع وفيات، بلا كهرباء: كواليس التعافي البطيء لمدينة غاري بولاية إنديانا من عاصفة بلغت سرعتها 99 ميلاً في الساعة

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: بعد مرور أكثر من أسبوع على اجتياح عاصفة عنيفة لشمال غرب ولاية إنديانا، لا تزال عشرات الآلاف من المنازل والشركات في غاري وأنحاء مقاطعة ليك بدون كهرباء، ويقول المسؤولون إن استعادة الخدمة بالكامل غير متوقعة قبل 25 أغسطس.

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: ووفقاً لمسؤولي إدارة الطوارئ المحليين، فقد تسببت العاصفة في هبوب رياح قُدّرت سرعتها بـ 99 ميلاً في الساعة، مما أدى إلى كسر أو إسقاط مئات من أعمدة المرافق وقطع خطوط الكهرباء في جميع أنحاء المنطقة.

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: وقد جعل حجم الأضرار هذا الانقطاع أحد أطول الانقطاعات الواسعة النطاق التي شهدتها المنطقة منذ سنوات.

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## حصيلة آخذة في الارتفاع

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: ربط المسؤولون سبع وفيات بالعاصفة وتداعياتها، على الرغم من أن السلطات حذرت من أن بعض هذه الوفيات قد تكون مرتبطة بالظروف الناجمة عن الانقطاع الطويل للكهرباء — مثل التعرض للحرارة الشديدة واستخدام مصادر بديلة للطاقة أو التدفئة — وليس بسبب العاصفة نفسها.

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: وتفيد التقارير بأن التحقيقات في الظروف الفردية لا تزال جارية، وحث المسؤولون السكان ووسائل الإعلام على الاعتماد على البيانات الرسمية بدلاً من التكهنات مع تأكيد التفاصيل.

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: ولم تنشر السلطات المحلية تفاصيل إضافية لتحديد هوية الضحايا، ويُطلب من السكان توجيه التعازي والاستفسارات عبر القنوات الرسمية للمقاطعة.

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## المدارس مغلقة، والفصول الدراسية مظلمة

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: ظلت المناطق التعليمية في منطقة غاري مغلقة منذ 13 أغسطس، عندما قطعت العاصفة الكهرباء لأول مرة عن المدارس في جميع أنحاء المدينة.

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: وأشار مسؤولو المنطقة التعليمية إلى أن غياب الكهرباء وتكييف الهواء وضغط المياه الموثوق به في بعض المباني هي الأسباب الرئيسية لإبقاء الطلاب في منازلهم، دون الإعلان عن موعد محدد لإعادة فتح المدارس بعد.

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: وقد تم نصح العائلات بمتابعة الاتصالات الرسمية للمنطقة التعليمية لمعرفة آخر المستجدات بشأن موعد استئناف الدراسة.

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## المراكز المجتمعية تصبح شريان حياة

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: مع استمرار افتقار العديد من الأسر للكهرباء والتبريد وتكييف الهواء خلال حرارة أواخر الصيف، تم تحويل المراكز المجتمعية المحلية والمباني البلدية إلى مواقع إغاثة مؤقتة.

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: وقد تمكن السكان من الحصول على:

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - وجبات ساخنة توزعها المنظمات المجتمعية والمتطوعون

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - محطات شحن للهواتف والأجهزة الإلكترونية الصغيرة

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - مناطق تبريد للهروب من درجات الحرارة المرتفعة داخل المنازل

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - إمدادات أساسية، بما في ذلك الماء والثلج، يتم توزيعها في مواقع مختارة

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: وقد شجع مسؤولو المدينة السكان المعرضين للمخاطر الصحية، أو كبار السن، أو من يرعون أطفالاً صغاراً على الاستفادة من هذه المواقع، لا سيما خلال أوقات ذروة الحرارة نهاراً.

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## طواقم المرافق تسابق الزمن

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: وتعمل طواقم المرافق، التي تدعمها تقارير تفيد بمشاركة فرق مساعدة متبادلة من الولايات المجاورة، على استبدال الأعمدة الساقطة، وإعادة مد الخطوط، وفحص البنية التحتية المتضررة في جميع أنحاء المنطقة المتأثرة.

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: وقال المسؤولون إن العدد الهائل من الأعمدة التي تتطلب استبدالاً كاملاً — بدلاً من مجرد إصلاح بسيط للخطوط — قد أبطأ بشكل كبير من وتيرة استعادة الخدمة مقارنة بجهود التعافي المعتادة من العواصف.

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: وقال ممثلو المرافق المحلية إن الأولوية في استعادة الخدمة تُمنح بناءً على عدد المشتركين الذين يمكن للإصلاح الواحد إعادتهم، حيث تحظى المستشفيات ومنشآت معالجة المياه وغيرها من البنى التحتية الحيوية باهتمام مبكر، تليها الأحياء التي تضم أكبر تجمع للسكان المتضررين.

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## ما يُطلب من السكان فعله

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: يواصل مسؤولو المقاطعة حث السكان على:

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - تجنب خطوط الكهرباء الساقطة والتعامل مع جميع الخطوط على أنها ناقلة للكهرباء حتى تؤكد طواقم المرافق غير ذلك

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - الإبلاغ عن انقطاع الكهرباء والخطوط الساقطة عبر الخطوط الساخنة الرسمية للمرافق والمقاطعة بدلاً من افتراض أن الطواقم على علم بها بالفعل

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - تفقد الجيران من كبار السن أو الفئات الضعيفة، خاصة خلال فترات بعد الظهر شديدة الحرارة

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - التخلص من الأطعمة المبردة التي بقيت دون كهرباء لفترة طويلة، باتباع الإرشادات الرسمية لسلامة الأغذية

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: ومع اقتراب المنطقة من الموعد المستهدف لاستعادة الخدمة في 25 أغسطس، قال المسؤولون المحليون إنهم سيواصلون تقديم المستجدات من خلال البيانات الرسمية مع تقدم أعمال الإصلاح.

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: ويُنصح السكان بمتابعة القنوات الحكومية وقنوات المرافق المحلية المعتمدة للحصول على أحدث المعلومات حول حالة الانقطاع، ومواقع الملاجئ، وخطط إعادة فتح المدار.

fr.title: Neuf jours, sept morts, pas d'électricité : Au cœur du lent rétablissement de Gary, dans l'Indiana, après une tempête à 99 MPH

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: Plus d'une semaine après qu'une violente tempête a frappé le nord-ouest de l'Indiana, des dizaines de milliers de foyers et d'entreprises à Gary et dans tout le comté de Lake restent privés d'électricité, et les autorités indiquent que le rétablissement complet n'est pas attendu avant le 25 août.

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: Selon les responsables locaux de la gestion des urgences, la tempête a produit des rafales de vent estimées à 99 miles par heure, brisant ou renversant des centaines de poteaux électriques et faisant tomber des lignes à travers la région.

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: L'ampleur des dégâts en fait l'une des pannes généralisées les plus longues que la région ait connues depuis des années.

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## Un bilan qui s'alourdit

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: Les autorités ont lié sept décès à la tempête et à ses séquelles, bien que les services compétents aient averti que certaines de ces fatalités pourraient être liées aux conditions causées par la panne prolongée — telles que l'exposition à une chaleur extrême et l'utilisation de sources d'énergie ou de chauffage d'appoint — plutôt qu'à la tempête elle-même.

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes sur les circonstances individuelles seraient toujours en cours, et les autorités ont exhorté les résidents et les médias à se fier aux déclarations officielles plutôt qu'aux spéculations à mesure que les détails sont confirmés.

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: Les autorités locales n'ont pas divulgué d'autres détails d'identification sur les victimes, et il est demandé aux résidents d'adresser leurs condoléances et leurs demandes de renseignements par les canaux officiels du comté.

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## Écoles fermées, classes dans le noir

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: Les districts scolaires de la région de Gary sont restés fermés depuis le 13 août, date à laquelle la tempête a privé d'électricité les campus de toute la ville.

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: Les responsables du district ont cité l'absence d'électricité, de climatisation et de pression d'eau fiable dans certains bâtiments comme principales raisons du maintien des élèves à la maison, sans qu'aucune date précise n'ait encore été annoncée pour la réouverture.

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: Il a été conseillé aux familles de suivre les communications officielles du district scolaire pour savoir quand les cours reprendront.

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## Les centres communautaires deviennent des bouées de sauvetage

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: Alors que de nombreux foyers manquent encore d'électricité, de réfrigération et de climatisation pendant cette chaleur de fin d'été, les centres communautaires locaux et les bâtiments municipaux ont été convertis en sites de secours de fortune.

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: Les résidents ont pu avoir accès à :

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - Des repas chauds distribués par des organisations communautaires et des bénévoles

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - Des stations de recharge pour téléphones et petits appareils électroniques

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - Des zones de rafraîchissement pour échapper aux températures intérieures élevées

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - Des fournitures de base, y compris de l'eau et de la glace, distribuées dans des lieux sélectionnés

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: Les autorités de la ville ont encouragé les résidents médicalement vulnérables, âgés ou s'occupant de jeunes enfants à utiliser ces sites, particulièrement pendant les pics de chaleur en journée.

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## Les équipes de dépannage engagées dans une course contre la montre

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: Les équipes des services publics, renforcées selon les rapports par des équipes d'entraide des États voisins, s'efforcent de remplacer les poteaux tombés, d'étirer de nouvelles lignes et d'inspecter les infrastructures endommagées dans toute la zone touchée.

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: Les autorités ont déclaré que le nombre élevé de poteaux nécessitant un remplacement complet — plutôt qu'une simple réparation de ligne — a considérablement ralenti le rythme du rétablissement par rapport aux efforts habituels après une tempête.

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: Les représentants des services publics locaux ont indiqué que le rétablissement est priorisé en fonction du nombre de clients qu'une réparation donnée peut réapprovisionner, les hôpitaux, les stations de traitement de l'eau et autres infrastructures critiques recevant une attention prioritaire, suivis des quartiers présentant les plus fortes concentrations de résidents touchés.

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## Ce qui est demandé aux résidents

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: Les autorités du comté continuent d'exhorter les résidents à :

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - Éviter les lignes électriques tombées au sol et traiter toutes les lignes comme étant sous tension jusqu'à confirmation contraire par les équipes de dépannage

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - Signaler les pannes et les lignes tombées via les numéros d'urgence officiels des services publics et du comté plutôt que de supposer que les équipes sont déjà informées

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - Prendre des nouvelles des voisins âgés ou vulnérables, en particulier pendant les après-midis de forte chaleur

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - Jeter les aliments réfrigérés qui sont restés sans électricité pendant une période prolongée, en suivant les consignes officielles de sécurité alimentaire

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: Alors que la région approche de l'objectif de rétablissement fixé au 25 août, les autorités locales ont déclaré qu'elles continueraient à fournir des mises à jour par le biais de déclarations officielles au fur et à mesure de l'avancement des travaux de réparation.

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: Les résidents sont encouragés à suivre les canaux vérifiés du gouvernement local et des services publics pour obtenir les informations les plus récentes sur l'état des pannes, l'emplacement des hébergements d'urgence et les plans de réouverture des écoles.

pt.title: Nove dias, sete mortes, sem luz: por dentro da lenta recuperação de Gary, Indiana, após uma tempestade de 99 mph

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: Mais de uma semana após uma tempestade violenta atingir o noroeste de Indiana, dezenas de milhares de casas e empresas em Gary e em todo o Condado de Lake permanecem sem eletricidade, e as autoridades dizem que a restauração completa não é esperada até 25 de agosto.

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: De acordo com autoridades locais de gestão de emergências, a tempestade produziu rajadas de vento estimadas em 99 milhas por hora, quebrando ou derrubando centenas de postes de serviços públicos e derrubando linhas de energia em toda a região.

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: A escala dos danos tornou esta uma das interrupções generalizadas mais longas que a área experimentou em anos.

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## Um pedágio crescente

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: As autoridades ligaram sete mortes à tempestade e suas consequências, embora as autoridades tenham alertado que algumas dessas fatalidades podem estar ligadas a condições causadas pela interrupção prolongada — como exposição ao calor extremo e o uso de fontes alternativas de energia ou aquecimento — em vez da tempestade em si.

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: Investigações sobre as circunstâncias individuais estariam ainda em andamento, e as autoridades pediram aos residentes e aos meios de comunicação que confiem nas declarações oficiais em vez de especulações à medida que os detalhes são confirmados.

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: As autoridades locais não divulgaram mais detalhes de identificação sobre as vítimas, e os residentes estão sendo solicitados a direcionar condolências e perguntas através dos canais oficiais do condado.

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## Escolas fechadas, salas de aula escuras

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: Os distritos escolares da área de Gary permaneceram fechados desde 13 de agosto, quando a tempestade cortou a energia dos campi em toda a cidade pela primeira vez.

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: As autoridades distritais citaram a falta de eletricidade, ar condicionado e pressão de água confiável em alguns edifícios como as principais razões para manter os alunos em casa, sem data definida ainda anunciada para a reabertura.

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: As famílias foram aconselhadas a monitorar as comunicações oficiais do distrito escolar para atualizações sobre quando as aulas serão retomadas.

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## Centros comunitários tornam-se tábuas de salvação

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: Com muitas famílias ainda sem energia, refrigeração e ar condicionado durante o calor do final do verão, centros comunitários locais e edifícios municipais foram convertidos em locais de socorro improvisados.

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: Os residentes puderam acessar:

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - Refeições quentes distribuídas por organizações comunitárias e voluntários

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - Estações de carregamento para telefones e pequenos eletrônicos

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - Áreas de resfriamento para escapar das altas temperaturas internas

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - Suprimentos básicos, incluindo água e gelo, distribuídos em locais selecionados

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: As autoridades municipais incentivaram os residentes que são medicamente vulneráveis, idosos ou que cuidam de crianças pequenas a fazer uso desses locais, particularmente durante o pico de calor diurno.

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## Equipes de serviços públicos correndo contra o relógio

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: Equipes de serviços públicos, supostamente suplementadas por equipes de ajuda mútua de estados vizinhos, têm trabalhado para substituir postes derrubados, reinstalar linhas e inspecionar a infraestrutura danificada em toda a área afetada.

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: As autoridades disseram que o grande número de postes que exigem substituição total — em vez de um simples reparo de linha — diminuiu significativamente o ritmo de restauração em comparação com os esforços típicos de recuperação de tempestades.

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: Representantes locais de serviços públicos disseram que a restauração está sendo priorizada com base no número de clientes que um determinado reparo pode restaurar, com hospitais, instalações de tratamento de água e outras infraestruturas críticas recebendo atenção inicial, seguidos por bairros com as maiores concentrações de residentes afetados.

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## O que está sendo dito aos residentes

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: As autoridades do condado continuam a instar os residentes a:

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - Evitar linhas de energia derrubadas e tratar todas as linhas como energizadas até que seja confirmado o contrário pelas equipes de serviços públicos

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - Relatar interrupções e linhas derrubadas através de linhas diretas oficiais de serviços públicos e do condado, em vez de presumir que as equipes já estão cientes

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - Verificar vizinhos idosos ou vulneráveis, particularmente durante as tardes de calor intenso

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance

in.title: Sembilan Hari, Tujuh Kematian, Tanpa Listrik: Di Dalam Pemulihan Lambat Gary, Indiana dari Badai Berkecepatan 99-MPH

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: Lebih dari seminggu setelah badai dahsyat menerjang Indiana barat laut, puluhan ribu rumah dan bisnis di Gary dan di seluruh Lake County masih tanpa listrik, dan para pejabat mengatakan pemulihan penuh tidak diharapkan hingga 25 Agustus.

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: Menurut pejabat manajemen darurat setempat, badai tersebut menghasilkan hembusan angin yang diperkirakan mencapai 99 mil per jam, mematahkan atau merubuhkan ratusan tiang listrik dan merobohkan kabel listrik di seluruh wilayah.

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: Skala kerusakan telah membuat ini menjadi salah satu pemadaman paling meluas yang dialami daerah tersebut dalam bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## Korban yang Terus Bertambah

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: Para pejabat telah mengaitkan tujuh kematian dengan badai dan dampaknya, meskipun pihak berwenang telah memperingatkan bahwa beberapa dari kematian tersebut mungkin terkait dengan kondisi yang disebabkan oleh pemadaman berkepanjangan — seperti paparan panas ekstrem dan penggunaan sumber daya atau pemanas alternatif — daripada badai itu sendiri.

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: Penyelidikan mengenai keadaan individu dilaporkan masih berlangsung, dan para pejabat mendesak warga serta media untuk mengandalkan pernyataan resmi daripada spekulasi saat rinciannya dikonfirmasi.

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: Pihak berwenang setempat belum merilis rincian identifikasi lebih lanjut tentang para korban, dan warga diminta untuk menyampaikan belasungkawa dan pertanyaan melalui saluran resmi wilayah.

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## Sekolah Ditutup, Ruang Kelas Gelap

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: Distrik sekolah di wilayah Gary tetap ditutup sejak 13 Agustus, ketika badai pertama kali memadamkan listrik ke kampus-kampus di seluruh kota.

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: Pejabat distrik mengutip kurangnya listrik, pendingin udara, dan tekanan air yang andal di beberapa bangunan sebagai alasan utama meliburkan siswa, tanpa tanggal pasti yang diumumkan untuk pembukaan kembali.

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: Keluarga telah disarankan untuk memantau komunikasi resmi distrik sekolah untuk pembaruan tentang kapan kelas akan dimulai kembali.

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## Pusat Komunitas Menjadi Tumpuan Harapan

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: Dengan banyak rumah tangga yang masih kekurangan listrik, pendingin makanan, dan pendingin udara selama cuaca panas di akhir musim panas, pusat-pusat komunitas lokal dan bangunan kotamadya telah diubah menjadi tempat bantuan darurat.

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: Warga telah dapat mengakses:

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - Makanan hangat yang didistribusikan oleh organisasi masyarakat dan relawan

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - Tempat pengisian daya untuk ponsel dan barang elektronik kecil

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - Area pendinginan untuk menghindari suhu dalam ruangan yang tinggi

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - Pasokan dasar, termasuk air dan es, yang didistribusikan di lokasi-lokasi tertentu

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: Pejabat kota telah mendorong warga yang rentan secara medis, lansia, atau merawat anak-anak kecil untuk memanfaatkan situs-situs ini, terutama selama puncak panas siang hari.

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## Petugas Listrik Berlomba dengan Waktu

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: Petugas utilitas, yang dilaporkan dibantu oleh tim bantuan bersama dari negara bagian tetangga, telah bekerja untuk mengganti tiang yang roboh, memasang kembali kabel, dan memeriksa infrastruktur yang rusak di seluruh wilayah yang terdampak.

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: Para pejabat mengatakan bahwa jumlah tiang yang membutuhkan penggantian penuh — alih-alih perbaikan kabel sederhana — telah memperlambat laju pemulihan secara signifikan dibandingkan dengan upaya pemulihan badai biasa.

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: Perwakilan utilitas lokal mengatakan pemulihan diprioritaskan berdasarkan jumlah pelanggan yang dapat dipulihkan oleh perbaikan tertentu, dengan rumah sakit, fasilitas pengolahan air, dan infrastruktur penting lainnya menerima perhatian awal, diikuti oleh lingkungan dengan konsentrasi warga terdampak terbesar.

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Disampaikan Kepada Warga

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: Pejabat wilayah terus mendesak warga untuk:

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - Menghindari kabel listrik yang jatuh dan memperlakukan semua kabel seolah dialiri listrik sampai dikonfirmasi sebaliknya oleh petugas utilitas

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - Melaporkan pemadaman dan kabel jatuh melalui saluran siaga resmi utilitas dan wilayah daripada berasumsi bahwa petugas sudah mengetahuinya

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - Memeriksa tetangga yang lansia atau rentan, terutama selama sore hari yang sangat panas

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - Membuang makanan berpendingin yang telah tanpa listrik dalam jangka waktu lama, mengikuti panduan keamanan pangan resmi

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: Saat wilayah tersebut mendekati target pemulihan yang diperkirakan pada 25 Agustus, pejabat setempat mengatakan mereka akan terus memberikan pembaruan melalui pernyataan resmi seiring berjalannya pekerjaan perbaikan.

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: Warga didorong untuk mengikuti saluran pemerintah daerah dan utilitas yang terverifikasi untuk informasi terbaru tentang status pemadaman, lokasi pengungsian, dan rencana pembukaan kembali sekolah.

ja.title: 9日間、7人の死者、停電：時速99マイルの嵐からのインディアナ州ゲーリーの遅々とした復旧の内側

segments.src: More than a week after a violent storm tore through northwest Indiana, tens of thousands of homes and businesses in Gary and across Lake County remain without electricity, and officials say full restoration is not expected until August 25.
segments.tr: 猛烈な嵐がインディアナ州北西部を襲ってから1週間以上が経過したが、ゲーリー市およびレイク郡全域の数万世帯の住宅や企業では依然として電気が復旧しておらず、当局は完全な復旧は8月25日まで見込めないと述べている。

segments.src: According to local emergency management officials, the storm produced wind gusts estimated at 99 miles per hour, snapping or toppling hundreds of utility poles and pulling down power lines across the region.
segments.tr: 地元の緊急事態管理当局によると、この嵐は時速99マイルと推定される突風をもたらし、地域全体で数百本の電柱が折れたり倒れたりし、送電線が切断された。

segments.src: The scale of the damage has made this one of the longest widespread outages the area has experienced in years.
segments.tr: 被害の規模は、この地域がここ数年で経験した中で最も長期にわたる広範囲な停電の一つとなっている。

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
segments.tr: ## 広がる犠牲

segments.src: Officials have linked seven deaths to the storm and its aftermath, though authorities have cautioned that some of those fatalities may be tied to conditions caused by the extended outage — such as extreme heat exposure and the use of alternative power or heating sources — rather than the storm itself.
segments.tr: 当局は7人の死者が嵐とその余波に関連しているとしているが、当局は、これらの死者のうちいくつかは、嵐そのものというよりも、極度の暑さへの曝露や代替の電力・暖房源の使用など、長期停電によって引き起こされた状況に関連している可能性があると警告している。

segments.src: Investigations into the individual circumstances are reportedly still underway, and officials have urged residents and news outlets to rely on official statements rather than speculation as details are confirmed.
segments.tr: 個々の状況に関する調査は現在も進行中であると報じられており、当局は住民や報道機関に対し、詳細が確認されるまでは憶測ではなく公式発表を信頼するよう強く求めている。

segments.src: Local authorities have not released further identifying details about the victims, and residents are being asked to direct condolences and inquiries through official county channels.
segments.tr: 地元当局は犠牲者に関する詳細な身元情報を公表しておらず、住民に対しては、お悔やみや問い合わせを公式の郡の窓口を通じて行うよう求めている。

segments.src: ## Schools Closed, Classrooms Dark
segments.tr: ## 学校は閉鎖、教室は暗闇に

segments.src: Gary-area school districts have remained closed since August 13, when the storm first knocked out power to campuses across the city.
segments.tr: ゲーリー地域の学区は、嵐が市内のキャンパスの電力を最初に遮断した8月13日以来、閉鎖されたままである。

segments.src: District officials have cited the lack of electricity, air conditioning, and reliable water pressure in some buildings as the primary reasons for keeping students home, with no firm date yet announced for reopening.
segments.tr: 学区当局は、一部の建物で電気、エアコン、安定した水圧が欠如していることを生徒を自宅待機させる主な理由として挙げており、再開の確実な日程はまだ発表されていない。

segments.src: Families have been advised to monitor official school district communications for updates on when classes will resume.
segments.tr: 各家庭には、授業がいつ再開されるかについて、公式の学区からの連絡を監視するよう助言されている。

segments.src: ## Community Centers Become Lifelines
segments.tr: ## コミュニティセンターが命綱に

segments.src: With many households still lacking power, refrigeration, and air conditioning during the late-summer heat, local community centers and municipal buildings have been converted into makeshift relief sites.
segments.tr: 夏の終わりの暑さの中で多くの世帯が依然として電力、冷蔵、エアコンを欠いているため、地元のコミュニティセンターや自治体の建物が臨時の救援拠点に転換されている。

segments.src: Residents have been able to access:
segments.tr: 住民は以下のサービスを利用できる：

segments.src: - Hot meals distributed by community organizations and volunteers
segments.tr: - 地域団体やボランティアによって配布される温かい食事

segments.src: - Charging stations for phones and small electronics
segments.tr: - 携帯電話や小型電子機器の充電ステーション

segments.src: - Cooling areas to escape high indoor temperatures
segments.tr: - 高い室内温度から逃れるための冷却エリア

segments.src: - Basic supplies, including water and ice, distributed at select locations
segments.tr: - 特定の場所で配布される水や氷を含む基本的な物資

segments.src: City officials have encouraged residents who are medically vulnerable, elderly, or caring for young children to make use of these sites, particularly during peak daytime heat.
segments.tr: 市当局は、医療的に脆弱な人、高齢者、または幼い子供の世話をしている住民に対し、特に日中の暑さがピークに達する時間帯にこれらの拠点を利用するよう奨励している。

segments.src: ## Utility Crews Racing Against the Clock
segments.tr: ## 時間との戦いに挑む電力復旧作業員

segments.src: Utility crews, reportedly supplemented by mutual-aid teams from neighboring states, have been working to replace downed poles, restring lines, and inspect damaged infrastructure across the affected footprint.
segments.tr: 近隣の州からの相互支援チームによって補強されたと報じられている電力復旧作業員は、被災地全域で倒れた電柱の交換、送電線の張り直し、損傷したインフラの点検作業に取り組んでいる。

segments.src: Officials have said that the sheer number of poles requiring full replacement — rather than simple line repair — has significantly slowed the pace of restoration compared with typical storm recovery efforts.
segments.tr: 当局は、単純な送電線の修理ではなく、完全な交換が必要な電柱の数が非常に多いため、通常の嵐の復旧作業と比較して復旧のペースが大幅に遅くなっていると述べている。

segments.src: Local utility representatives have said restoration is being prioritized based on the number of customers a given repair can restore, with hospitals, water treatment facilities, and other critical infrastructure receiving early attention, followed by neighborhoods with the largest concentrations of affected residents.
segments.tr: 地元の電力会社の担当者は、病院、浄水施設、その他の重要なインフラが早期の対応を受け、その次に被災した住民が最も集中している地域が続くなど、修理によって復旧できる顧客数に基づいて復旧の優先順位が付けられていると述べている。

segments.src: ## What Residents Are Being Told
segments.tr: ## 住民への伝達事項

segments.src: County officials continue to urge residents to:
segments.tr: 郡当局は引き続き住民に対し、以下のことを強く求めている：

segments.src: - Avoid downed power lines and treat all lines as energized until confirmed otherwise by utility crews
segments.tr: - 倒れた送電線には近づかず、電力会社の作業員によって確認されるまではすべての送電線が通電しているものとして扱うこと

segments.src: - Report outages and downed lines through official utility and county hotlines rather than assuming crews are already aware
segments.tr: - 作業員がすでに状況を把握していると想定するのではなく、公式の電力会社や郡のホットラインを通じて停電や倒れた送電線を報告すること

segments.src: - Check on elderly or vulnerable neighbors, particularly during high-heat afternoons
segments.tr: - 特に暑い午後の時間帯には、高齢者や脆弱な隣人の様子を確認すること

segments.src: - Discard refrigerated food that has been without power for an extended period, following official food-safety guidance
segments.tr: - 公式の食品安全ガイダンスに従い、長期間電力が供給されていない冷蔵食品は廃棄すること

segments.src: As the region approaches the projected August 25 restoration target, local officials have said they will continue to provide updates through official statements as repair work progresses.
segments.tr: 地域が予定されている8月25日の復旧目標に近づくにつれ、地元当局は修理作業の進捗に合わせて公式声明を通じて最新情報を提供し続けると述べている。

segments.src: Residents are encouraged to follow verified local government and utility channels for the most current information on outage status, shelter locations, and school reopening plans.
segments.tr: 住民は、停電状況、避難所の場所、学校再開計画に関する最新情報を得るために、検証済みの地方自治体および電力会社のチャンネルをフォローすることが推奨される。

segments.src: ## A Widening Toll
